objects.name: work_item
objects.description: One piece of work an agency's operator owes: the unit a role holder picks up and is answerable for.

indexes.name: objective
indexes.description: Reads one objective's board, which is the agency's own front screen.

objects.name: step
objects.description: One ordered step a work item was broken into, small enough for a single role holder to finish in one sitting.

objects.name: operator
objects.description: Whoever the agency hands work to — a person in a seat or a scheduled agent standing in for one.

objects.name: objective
objects.description: What the agency is trying to achieve, and the container the work items serving it are grouped under.

objects.name: label
objects.description: A free-form label the agency sorts its own work by, such as a sector or a customer.

objects.name: output
objects.description: What a work item has to hand over before the agency counts it as finished.

objects.name: check
objects.description: A condition the agency verifies before accepting an output, written so anyone can check it the same way.

objects.name: workflow_run
objects.description: One pass of the agency's routine, anchoring every work item and step that pass produced.

objects.name: import_job
objects.description: One asynchronous load of an objective and its work items out of a template.

objects.name: gate
objects.description: A hard hold keeping one work item shut until another is finished.

objects.name: precedence
objects.description: A soft ordering recording that one work item follows another, with nothing enforced.

objects.name: objective_membership
objects.description: Records that one work item serves one objective.

objects.name: labelling
objects.description: Records that one label is attached to one work item.

objects.name: code_sequence
objects.description: The next number to mint for one kind of thing's stable code.
